tools.name: aeon_overview
tools.description: What aeon is: an open-source, MIT-licensed autonomous agent framework you fork and run on your own GitHub Actions. Returns a short overview.

tools.name: aeon_setup_command
tools.description: The one-line command to paste into any coding agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) to stand up an aeon instance.

tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List aeon's machine-readable resources: llms.txt, agents.md, the OpenAPI spec, the Agent Skills index, the setup skill, and the source repository.

tools.name: list_skills
tools.description: List aeon's skills from the live catalog. Optionally filter to one category (core, basics, crypto, dev, productivity, evolution).

category.description: Category id to filter by. Omit to list every skill.

tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search aeon's pages and skill catalog by keyword or natural-language question and get back the most relevant resources (name, url, description). This is the single retrieval tool - same ranked results as the NLWeb /ask endpoint.
